import pandas as pd

def run(inputs: dict[str, "pd.DataFrame"]) -> dict[str, "pd.DataFrame"]:
    postings = inputs["postings"].copy()

    # Sort according to cursor order: account_id, post_date, post_seq
    postings = postings.sort_values(
        by=["account_id", "post_date", "post_seq"],
        kind="mergesort"
    ).reset_index(drop=True)

    # Determine validity of each row
    valid_mask = (
        postings["qty"].notna()
        & (postings["qty"] > 0)
        & postings["unit_price"].notna()
        & (postings["unit_price"] >= 0)
    )

    valid_rows = postings[valid_mask].copy()
    invalid_rows = postings[~valid_mask].copy()

    # Compute post_value and running_total for valid rows, per account, in sorted order
    valid_rows["post_value"] = valid_rows["qty"] * valid_rows["unit_price"]
    valid_rows["running_total"] = valid_rows.groupby("account_id")["post_value"].cumsum()

    posted_totals = valid_rows[
        ["account_id", "post_seq", "post_date", "post_value", "running_total"]
    ].reset_index(drop=True)

    # Reject counts: count invalid rows per account, including zero for accounts with none
    all_accounts = postings["account_id"].drop_duplicates()
    reject_count_series = invalid_rows.groupby("account_id").size()

    reject_counts = pd.DataFrame({"account_id": all_accounts})
    reject_counts["reject_count"] = reject_counts["account_id"].map(reject_count_series).fillna(0).astype("int64")
    reject_counts = reject_counts.sort_values("account_id", kind="mergesort").reset_index(drop=True)

    return {
        "posted_totals": posted_totals,
        "reject_counts": reject_counts,
    }
